design.name: 御剑寒灵
design.brief: The frozen ghost of a Taoist sword immortal who flies on swords: a translucent-looking but solid pale-blue spirit figure in flowing Taoist robes and a lotus crown, long white hair and beard streaming backwards, hollow glowing jade-green eyes, its lower body fading into a tapering frost wisp instead of legs, floating; a fan of six ice-blue flying swords hovers in a half-ring behind its back, and a glowing jade-green talisman seal burns on its chest (weak spot). Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers making a sword-finger gesture. Serene and deadly.
design.weapon: a sword-finger gesture (index and middle finger raised) sending the flying swords forward
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps. The flying swords float by magic; it holds nothing in its hands.
